summary_for_children: Quraysh reminds the people of Quraysh of their safe caravan journeys in winter and summer, and calls them to worship the Lord of the House who fed them and kept them safe.
environment_concept: A desert road with two resting caravans of camels and loads, one with winter wraps and one with summer shades (106:2). A well and baskets of food stand by the road (106:4). The House of 106:3 is seen far off in a valley, simply, without detail. No people are shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Two caravan camps, a well with baskets, a far valley with a simple cube house.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A caravan camp in rocky desert hills at dusk with tents, a map table and four fire rings

primary_mechanic.text: At the map table choose the road for the winter caravan (south, where it is warm) and the summer caravan (north, where it is cooler); the wrong road is refused with the season's weather. Then keep four fires burning through a 40-second night: each burns down in 14 seconds, adding wood to a fire still burning well is refused, and while any fire is out the night does not pass (106:4, safe from fear).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the caravan road, the map and the night watch, then a reading above the camp
world_assets: four fire rings with flames and light
environment_behaviour: the sky turns to night during the watch; each flame shrinks as its fuel burns down
unique_world.learning_objective: Thank and worship the Lord who feeds us against hunger and makes us safe from fear (106:3-4)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Journeys of Safety
story_library.children_narration: The people of Quraysh traveled on trading journeys in winter and summer. Surah Quraysh reminds them of the safety and provision they enjoyed and calls them to worship the Lord of the Sacred House.

world_idea.title: The Two Caravan Routes
world_idea.description: Explore two distinctly different travel environments representing winter and summer journeys. Children organize fictional caravan supplies and learn about gratitude and safe travel.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
